thesis: Disenchant set the baseline for flexible sideboard interaction by answering either an artifact or enchantment for two mana at instant speed.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The archive tracks Disenchant from the first Worlds through white control, prison, combo sideboards, and official products that taught generations to respect artifacts and enchantments.

playbook.role: Hold it for the permanent that actually constrains the game, not the first legal target. Instant speed allows end-step exchanges, combat blowouts against Equipment, and protection from lock pieces.

counterplay.directAnswers: Diversify threats, force the white player to spend it early, and use recursion or enter-the-battlefield artifacts so the exchange is not clean.
